clue.text: Blair could be a skilled craftsman

definitions.meaning: a Prime Minister such as Tony Blair picks the ministers who form the government's top team
a joiner who builds fine wooden cupboards and furniture

explanation.surface: Tony Blair might have had a second career as an expert woodworker.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'cabinet' politically for the first sense: a Prime Minister makes up a Cabinet of senior ministers. The second sense is the furniture trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A furniture joiner is literally a maker of cabinets, and a premier assembles a government Cabinet.

clue.text: They ignore boats

definitions.meaning: people who cut someone dead deliberately ignore them
small single-masted sailing vessels, or a ship's boats

explanation.surface: A group pointedly snubbing some vessels.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut a person is to snub them, so snubbers are cutters; a cutter is also a type of small boat.

clue.text: One so held by Tony to be a blessing

indicators.note: being held by something means sitting inside it, so these letters go within the name

parts.note: Tony Benn, the veteran Labour politician
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Tony Benn grasping some single thing that proves a godsend.
explanation.walkthrough: Tony here is Tony Benn, the left-wing Labour veteran, not Tony Blair from 1-across.
explanation.definitionFit: A benison is an old literary word for a benediction or blessing.

clue.text: He proposes someone to monitor an order

indicators.note: putting letters in a new order means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man recommends a person to oversee a regulation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a noun after 'an', but it is the signal to rearrange the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: One who nominates a candidate is someone who puts that person forward or proposes them.

clue.text: Subject for discussion by Lawrence about border

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the initials go round the border word

parts.note: T. E. Lawrence, 'Lawrence of Arabia', is known by his initials
a hem is the border of a piece of cloth

explanation.surface: A talk topic offered by Lawrence concerning a frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: Lawrence of Arabia is conventionally clued by his initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme is the main topic or subject that a talk or essay deals with.

clue.text: Eric upset by girl's greed

indicators.note: something upset is knocked over and disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Eric is distressed by a young woman's grasping nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice is an extreme desire for wealth, a synonym of greed.

clue.text: End former meter error

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: an error suggests the letters have gone wrong and are scrambled

explanation.surface: Finish off an old measuring device that has gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End' looks like a verb, but it is a noun meaning the furthest limit.
explanation.definitionFit: An extreme is the furthest point or end of something, as in 'from one extreme to the other'.

clue.text: Roughly trace girl in freehand

indicators.note: something done roughly is not exact, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An artist sketches a girl without ruling lines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freehand' is read as one idea, a free hand to act as one pleases.
explanation.definitionFit: Carte blanche means complete freedom of action, a free hand to do as one likes.

clue.text: It's the opposite of a thousand to an old Roman

indicators.note: to means added onto, so the letter is joined after the Roman

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Something contrary to the thousand an ancient Roman owned.
explanation.walkthrough: M is added to ANTONY.
explanation.definitionFit: An antonym is a word of opposite meaning, as hot is to cold.

clue.text: It's lace that is flexible

indicators.note: something flexible bends into a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of it's, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A remark on lace that bends easily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flexible' rearranges ITSLACE into the answer, and the whole clue also describes the stretchy cord.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic is a stretchy flexible cord, and lace can be made with it.

clue.text: Cheap greens I order, being parsimonious

indicators.note: putting letters in order means arranging them afresh

explanation.surface: A diner orders inexpensive vegetables, being tight with money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like the diner ordering food, but it rearranges CHEAP GREENS I.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheese-paring describes stingy thrift, like paring the rind off cheese to save scraps.

clue.text: Silly tear shed by child shows disloyalty

indicators.note: silly means foolish or muddled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A child cries foolishly, revealing betrayal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed by' just links the rearranged letters to the child.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country, the gravest form of disloyalty.

clue.text: Effeminate niece broke record first

indicators.note: first means this piece comes at the front

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: broke means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An effeminate relative smashed a record at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Epicene means having characteristics of both sexes, and so effeminate in a man.

clue.text: Vessel is back, caught by ban

indicators.note: caught by the outer word means held inside it
back means the little word is turned round

explanation.surface: A ship returns only to be seized under an embargo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship, but it is a bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A basin is a bowl, a vessel for holding water.

clue.text: Showing lack of judgement, so do not try so many!

definitions.text: so do not try so many!

explanation.surface: A gourmet is told off for crassness and advised to sample fewer dishes.
explanation.walkthrough: The second part is cryptic: 'try' means sample, so trying fewer is tasting less.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteless means vulgar, lacking aesthetic discernment, and split in two it means sample fewer.

clue.text: Betray Clare?

definitions.meaning: to let someone down or undervalue them
Clare Short, the Labour MP who quit Tony Blair's cabinet

explanation.surface: Asking whether Clare is a traitor.
explanation.walkthrough: Clare Short was a Labour cabinet minister who resigned over the Iraq war; the question mark flags the pun on her surname.
explanation.definitionFit: To sell short is to undervalue or betray someone; it is also a playful way of trading in Clare Short.

clue.text: A rule aunt adopted about appearing in the nude

indicators.note: letters adopted into a new family take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An aunt adopts a policy on appearing naked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adopted' rearranges A RULE AUNT; 'about appearing' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Au naturel is a French phrase for being naked, in one's natural state.

clue.text: Little Ann's liking for cloth

parts.note: Nan is a pet form of the name Ann
keen means fond of, having a liking for something

explanation.surface: Little Ann has a taste for a particular fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Nankeen is a yellowish cotton cloth originally made in Nanking.

clue.text: Cured editor on outing

indicators.note: on means placed after, as one piece follows another in a down entry

parts.note: a treat is a special trip or outing

explanation.surface: An editor recovered while on a day trip.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'on' places one piece after another.
explanation.definitionFit: Treated can mean cured by medical care, or preserved as with smoked meat.

clue.text: Man in headgear of little value

indicators.note: in means the man's word sits inside the headgear

parts.note: a cap is a piece of headgear

explanation.surface: A chap wearing an inexpensive hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap means low in price or worth, so of little value.

clue.text: Not disturbed in murderer's hold

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the name

parts.note: Cain, who killed his brother Abel, is the Bible's first murderer

indicators.note: disturbed means stirred up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A killer's grip remained steady.
explanation.walkthrough: Cain, who slew Abel in Genesis, is the crossword's stock murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: To contain is to hold within, as a jug holds water.

clue.text: Measure string for knot

parts.note: an en is a printer's measure of width

explanation.surface: Measure some string to tie a knot.
explanation.walkthrough: EN is the printing measure half the width of an em.
explanation.definitionFit: To entwine is to twist together, so to knot or interlace things.

clue.text: Satisfied with French storybook

parts.note: conte is French for a short story or tale
NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: Happy with a French storybook.
explanation.definitionFit: Content means happy and at ease, a synonym of satisfied.

clue.text: Extract from chapter seen to be concise

indicators.note: Extract from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A passage from a chapter, viewed as a model of brevity.
explanation.definitionFit: Terse means brief and to the point, using few words.

clue.text: Law maker sent round a round robin initially

indicators.note: sent round a means the word goes around the letter

parts.note: a round object is shaped like the letter O

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A legislator circulated a petition signed by everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: SENT around A makes SENAT, then O and R from robin.
explanation.definitionFit: A senator is a member of a senate, a body that makes laws.

clue.text: He votes for Hanoverian prince

definitions.meaning: a person who casts a ballot
the ruler of Hanover held a title as one of the princes who chose the Holy Roman Emperor

explanation.surface: A voter backs a German royal.
explanation.walkthrough: The rulers of Hanover were Electors of the Holy Roman Empire.
explanation.definitionFit: An elector is someone entitled to vote, and also one of the German princes who elected the Emperor.

clue.text: Put oar into confused speech

indicators.note: confused means jumbled, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone puts an oar into a muddled address.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' looks like a link but is part of the letters rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An oration is a formal speech.

clue.text: Never acted in production by mistake

indicators.note: a production remakes material in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor who never performed in a show by accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link but belongs to the rearranged letters NEVER ACTED IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Inadvertence is an oversight, a mistake made through carelessness.
